evals.prompt: Build me a habit tracker. (Golden task 11, after research and intake: the round closed with 'defaults'; the intake record sets a first-value budget of 3 taps to the first habit.)
evals.expected_output: docs/spec/v1.md in decision 83's grammar: the six front matter lines with status draft and supersedes none, the six sections in order, P1 stories forming the walking skeleton, at least one EARS criterion per story including the first-value budget and the empty, loading, error and offline states, and assumptions marked fixed or delegated with defaults labeled 'default accepted'. jarvis spec check passes, the spec-reader checks it in a fresh context, and the confirmation goes out as a one-question round through jarvis intake send.
expectations: The first six lines are exactly ---, spec: 1, date: <today>, status: draft, supersedes: none, ---
The ## headings are exactly Goals, Non-goals, User stories, Acceptance criteria, Assumptions, Open questions, in that order
Every story has at least one criterion of the form - **ACn (Sm):** WHEN … THE SYSTEM SHALL …
One criterion states the first-value budget of 3 taps or fewer
Empty, error and offline states appear as criteria for the main screen
Every accepted default appears as a [delegated] assumption labeled 'default accepted'
The spec-reader is given the spec and PRODUCT.md, not the intake conversation
The confirmation round has one question with id CONFIRM, topic scope and the default 'Yes, build as written', and is sent with jarvis intake send

evals.prompt: I want a feature that finds the recruiter for each job I apply to, or the hiring manager if it can't find one, and reaches out to them. (Golden task 1, after research and intake on the FreeHire snapshot; the backlog rules out a follow-up campaign and requires approval for every message.)
evals.expected_output: A spec whose Non-goals name 'no follow-ups' with the backlog as its source, whose fixed assumptions carry the project's rules (approval for every message, send-only Gmail scope, no spending without approval) with sources, and whose criteria state that nothing is sent without the user's approval of the exact message.
expectations: Non-goals include no follow-up messages, citing the backlog
The approval rule, the send-only Gmail scope and the no-spend rule are [fixed] assumptions with sources
A criterion says the system sends exactly the approved message and nothing without approval
No story or criterion schedules a follow-up
Nothing is sent and docs/decisions.md is not edited by hand

evals.prompt: The citizenship filter is missing some jobs that require US citizenship. (Triage: bug, tier 0.)
evals.expected_output: Tier 0: no spec is written and nothing is sent for confirmation; the work goes to reproduce, failing test, fix, checks.
expectations: No file is written under docs/spec/
No confirmation round is sent
The response names the tier-0 path

evals.prompt: (Mid-run, the habit tracker's v1 is confirmed and tasks depend on it.) jarvis steer: 'Habits should be shared with one accountability partner.' This changes P1 story S2.
evals.expected_output: A new file docs/spec/v2.md with spec: 2, supersedes: 1 and status unconfirmed. v1 is not edited. Unchanged stories, criteria and assumptions keep their IDs; the changed story keeps S2; new entries take new numbers and no removed ID is reused. v2 passes jarvis spec check and the fresh-context reader, but no confirmation round is sent: confirmation happened once, at the initial hand-off (decision 86). The steer decision is recorded with jarvis decide, citing v2, and the runner replans only the tasks that depended on S2.
expectations: docs/spec/v1.md is byte-for-byte unchanged
docs/spec/v2.md has spec: 2, supersedes: 1 and status: unconfirmed
IDs of unchanged entries are the same in v1 and v2, and no ID removed in v2 is reused for a different entry
jarvis spec check and the spec-reader run on v2
No round file is written and jarvis intake send is not run
The change is recorded with jarvis decide including --why, citing docs/spec/v2.md

evals.prompt: (Habit tracker v1 draft.) The spec-reader reports that nothing says whether a missed day breaks a streak, which changes what the user sees.
evals.expected_output: No second round of questions. The gap becomes a [delegated] assumption with the default the intake would have offered, labeled 'default unconfirmed', listed first in the confirmation page. The reader's finding and the fix are written in the intake record under 'Spec check v1', not in docs/spec/.
expectations: No new product question round is sent besides the confirmation
The streak rule appears as a [delegated] assumption labeled 'default unconfirmed'
The confirmation summary lists it among the unconfirmed assumptions
No file other than vN.md is written in docs/spec/

evals.prompt: (The confirmation round for v1 was sent. Nobody answers; the second jarvis intake answers 1 --wait 540 call returns 'defaults (unconfirmed)'.)
evals.expected_output: The status line of v1 changes from draft to unconfirmed, nothing else in the file changes, and the skill hands off without waiting further. It made at most two bounded wait calls and runs no timer of its own.
expectations: v1 now reads status: unconfirmed and is otherwise unchanged
jarvis intake answers was called with --wait 540 no more than twice, and nothing else polled
The hand-off lists the unconfirmed assumption IDs

evals.prompt: (Mid-run, habit tracker v1 confirmed.) A repair task finds the free sync provider the spec assumes (A5, delegated) has shut down; the only alternative is a paid plan.
evals.expected_output: The change needs a choice outside what the user delegated (spending), so no new spec version is written and no confirmation round is sent: the affected tasks go to decision 40's blocked state and the rest of the plan continues.
expectations: No docs/spec/v2.md is written
No round is sent through jarvis intake send
The sync tasks are reported as blocked, waiting for the user, and other tasks continue
